text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとティーダは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Tidus are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとティーダは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: Although you and Tidus are a little different, your feelings will still resonate.

text.jp:
あなたと同じく、あきらめず走り続けた。
それがティーダの物語でした。
text.official_en: Tidus’s story played out in much the same fashion: with him refusing to give in as he pressed on.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... Your feelings have reached me.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
ええ、誰もがそう思うはず。
ティーダもあなたと同じでした。
text.official_en: Such a decision is only natural. Many—including Tidus—would make it as well.
text.real_en: Yes, that is what anyone would wish for. Tidus was no different.

text.jp:
けれど父がスピラのために選んだ運命を知り、
その歩みを追いかけてゆくのです。
text.official_en: When he came to understand, however, why Jecht did what he did for Spira, Tidus chose to follow after him.
text.real_en: But when he learned of the fate his father had chosen for Spira, he followed in his footsteps.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
そしてティーダは、魔獣『シン』との戦いに
命を捧げる召喚士たちの覚悟を知ります。
text.official_en: As time passed, Tidus came to learn of the summoners’ true fate: they must sacrifice themselves in order to vanquish Sin.

text.jp: それは、死の螺旋に囚われた異界の記憶――
text.official_en: In this tale, a spiral of death coiled tightly around the land—
text.real_en: A memory of another world trapped in a spiral of death...

text.jp:
それはユウナの希望ではなかった……。
想いをたしかめ、ふたりはともに前を向きます。
text.official_en: Alas, it was not to be, as Yuna did not will it. Yet their conversation did allow them to reach an understanding.
text.real_en: But that was not what Yuna wanted... After sharing their feelings, they faced the future together.

text.jp:
そんな世界に流れ着いた、
ひとりの若者がいました。
text.official_en: Amidst this conflict, a young man drifted onto Spira’s shores.

text.jp: とにかく止めようとあがく
text.official_en: Do everything possible to prevent their death.
text.real_en: Struggle to stop them, whatever it takes.

text.jp:
ともに歩んだ召喚士ユウナの決意を知り、
ティーダは、想いを試されます。
text.official_en: After finally understanding what it meant for Yuna to undertake her pilgrimage, he was at a crossroads.
text.real_en: When Tidus learned of the resolve of Yuna, the summoner traveling at his side, his own feelings were put to the test.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
どんな過去だろうと、目をそむけない。
立ち向かう強い意思が伝わります。
text.official_en: Such admirable resolve; even should your past prove a vexing sight, you would not avert your gaze from it.
text.real_en: You would not turn away from your past, whatever it held. Your answer shows the strength to face it.

text.jp: もう二度と関わらない
text.official_en: Nothing.
text.real_en: Never have anything to do with him again.

text.jp:
やがてティーダは、行方知れずの父ジェクトが
スピラに来ていたことを知ります。
text.official_en: As his journey progressed, Tidus learned that Jecht—his missing father—had made his way to Spira.

text.jp:
ティーダの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Tidus’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
ティーダは、誰も死なせない覚悟を決めました。
たとえ自分の存在が消えても……。
text.official_en: Tidus, however, decided to honor everyone else’s life, even if it meant it would come at the expense of his own.
text.real_en: Tidus, however, resolved not to let anyone die... even if his own existence vanished.

text.jp:
ティーダはとまどいながらも素直に
スピラの人々と気持ちを交わしたのです。
text.official_en: Yet, in spite of the inherent challenges, Tidus did exactly that with many of those whom he met in Spira.
text.real_en: Though confused at first, Tidus spoke openly with the people of Spira and shared his feelings with them.

text.jp:
ティーダも、父との戦いを選びました。
……わだかまりを越えて、父を救うために。
text.official_en: Tidus, too, looked his past in the eye and faced it head-on. He would save his father by doing battle against him.
text.real_en: Tidus chose to fight his father too... to overcome their bitterness and save him.

text.jp:
世界を救うためでも、絶対に死なせない。
方法がわからなくても、立ち止まらない。
text.official_en: You believe no one should have to sacrifice themselves; though you may not know another way, you know one must exist.
text.real_en: Even if it is to save the world, you refuse to let anyone die. You will not stop, even if you do not yet know how.

text.jp: 信じられる人を探す
text.official_en: Find someone trustworthy.

text.jp: 全部忘れて逃げようと誘う
text.official_en: Tell them to forget it all and run away with you.

text.jp:
前向きな答えですね。
ティーダもそうでした。
text.official_en: An optimistic answer—and one that resembles Tidus’s.

text.jp:
召喚士の旅をやめて、自由に生きてみる。
そう提案したティーダでしたが……
text.official_en: Tidus proposed a similar idea to Yuna: forsake her pilgrimage and live life on her own terms.

text.jp:
大事な人が決めたなら、辛くても受け入れる。
寄り添う者としての、真摯な思いやりです。
text.official_en: Your compassion is compelling; no matter how much it would hurt, you would accept their decision, for it is theirs to make.
text.real_en: Even though it hurts, you would accept the decision of someone dear to you. That is sincere compassion from someone standing beside them.

text.jp:
大切な人が、世界を救うために
自分を犠牲にしようとしている――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were someone you not only knew but cherished dearly poised to sacrifice themselves for the sake of the world, what would you do?

text.jp:
大嫌いなまま、姿を消した父親が
世界のどこかにいると知ったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to discover that your father—who you have resented for some time—disappeared to the world you now inhabit, what would you do?
text.real_en: If you learned that the father you had hated when he disappeared was somewhere in this world, what would you do?

text.jp:
嫌っていた父への、憎しみだけでない想いに
気づいていたからこそ、父の背中を追ったのです。
text.official_en: Though Tidus did loathe Jecht, he realized he harbored other feelings toward his father as well, hence why he followed in his footsteps.

text.jp:
幼い自分を何度も泣かせた父親は
いつか乗り越えたい目標でもありました。
text.official_en: The man he loathed for driving him to tears—yet also admired for his skills—was now close by.
text.real_en: The father who had made him cry so many times as a child was also someone he had always wanted to surpass.

text.jp:
彼の名は、ティーダ……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That young man’s name was Tidus, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Tidus... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
復活をくりかえす魔獣『シン』と
召喚士たちの戦いがつづく世界、スピラ。
text.official_en: A land called Spira, where an ages-old conflict between summoners and a monstrous beast known as Sin saw no end.
text.real_en: Spira, a world where summoners fought the endlessly resurrecting monster Sin.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp: 故郷に帰りたいと願う
text.official_en: Try to return home.
text.real_en: Wish to return to your homeland.

text.jp:
故郷のザナルカンドに帰りたいからこそ
スピラという未知の世界に踏み込んだのです。
text.official_en: In fact, his desire to return home is what drove him onward—deeper into the uncharted territory that was Spira.

text.jp: 新しい世界になじもうとする
text.official_en: Learn to live in this new world.

text.jp:
未知の世界で、誰かを信じる。
たやすいことではありません。
text.official_en: To find someone you can trust in your own world is no simple feat, let alone when you are in another.

text.jp:
死の螺旋に囚われた異界の幻影　ティーダ
召喚士を支え、悪しき夢想を断つ。
text.official_en:
Dream Dispeller Tidus
The blitzball player who awoke in a new world and became the guardian of a summoner.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision trapped in the spiral of death: Tidus. He supports a summoner and brings a dark dream to an end.

text.jp: 父の手がかりを探す
text.official_en: Search for clues as to his whereabouts.

text.jp:
突然たったひとりで
知らない世界に放り出されたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to lose consciousness, then suddenly awaken alone in a strange land, what would you do?
text.real_en: If you were suddenly thrown into an unfamiliar world, all alone, what would you do?

text.jp: 見つけ出して父と戦う
text.official_en: Find him and settle the score.
text.real_en: Find him and fight him.

text.jp:
見知らぬ世界の常識にとまどいながら
自分にできることを、追い求めたのです。
text.official_en: While much of what was considered common sense in Spira seemed alien to him, he sought to adjust as best he could.
text.real_en: Though bewildered by the customs of a strange world, he sought out what he himself could do.

text.jp: 覚悟を受けとめて賛成する
text.official_en: Honor their decision.

text.jp:
過去と向きあうため、自分の目でたしかめる。
ティーダもそうでした。
text.official_en: You feel, as did Tidus, that you could not confront your past without first confronting him.
text.real_en: You would see him for yourself so you could face your past. Tidus felt the same.

text.jp:
過去は過去だから、ふりむかない。
ティーダもはじめは、父と距離をとりました。
text.official_en: You feel the past should remain exactly that. Tidus, too, in the beginning, distanced himself from his father.
